newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudi Arabia tenders for 700,000 tonnes of barley.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia tenders for 700,000 tonnes of barley.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday launched an import tender to purchase 700,000 tonnes of feed barley from the world market, European grain traders said.
The barley, of any origin, is due to be delivered in July and offers at the tender are due on May 19, the traders said.
Traders said 250,000 tonnes was to be delivered to Dammam and 450,000 to the Red Sea port of Jeddah.

Countries set to compete for what is likely to be the last significant purchase from last year's harvests include Canada, Australia, the United States and the 15-nation European Union, grain traders said.
European feed barley is currently worth around $150 a tonne.
